dedupe_keys.name: corralanna peatland storm event water quality 2021 2023

description: This dataset records storm-event effluent chemistry at the Corralanna industrial cutaway peatland in Ireland. University College Dublin and Teesside University researchers sampled fourteen storms from March 2021 to March 2023, covering six lower-flow and eight higher-flow events. Measurements include nutrients, dissolved carbon, ions, pH, conductivity and carbon aromaticity, with six to twenty-three samples per event. Sampling intensified during rising and peak flows before slowing during recession. Mendeley version 2 provides one Excel workbook free under CC BY 4.0. Geographic coverage is one 16.4-hectare catchment. Event selection, unequal sample counts and concentration-flow timing are limitations for estimating continuous annual loads. Modellers could calibrate pollutant-export components or test drainage-treatment scenarios using model-epa-swmm or platform-goldsim-mine-water-waste. Separate deposits contain high-frequency flow and pond grab samples from the same programme. No chemical measurements were downloaded, and no concentration model or nutrient balance was reproduced.
